---
applyTo: "_pages/**/*.md,_projects/**/*.md,_news/**/*.md"
---

# Markdown content

- Prefer plain Markdown and existing al-folio front matter.
- Keep team content in `_pages/team/`, project content in `_projects/`, and page-level copy in `_pages/`.
- Avoid custom HTML and CSS when Markdown or a built-in al-folio feature provides the same result.
- Preserve established permalinks and navigation order unless the user requests a change.
